tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gter gsar thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprug gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// 1$0000300snang ba mtha' yas 'phags mchog 'jig rten mgon// padmāka ra dbyings phyug bde chen rgyal// chos rgyal yab sras thugs rje'i gter rnams la// gsol ba 'debs so 'khor ba dong sprug shog /snyigs ma'i 'gro 'dul mchog gyur bden chen gling*// brgyud pa'i bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon po dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong la// gsol ba 'debs so 'khor ba dong sprug shog /rang don spros bral chos sku mngon gyur nas// gzhan don lhun grub gzugs sku'i phrin las can// nam mkha' ji srid rgyun chad mi mnga' ba// spyan ras gzigs dbang go 'phang myur thob shog /
ces dge sbyong karma lha dpal thugs bzhed ltar blo gros mtha' yas kyis spel ba dge// /
